$comment: One gameplay gym plan per project, kept in the project (for example tools/gym-plan.json) and updated after every round. inventory rows come from source, with owner as path:line and numbers copied from code. Every inventory row maps to at least one room question or carries not_in_gym. Each room question has an expected value and tolerance written before the room is built. status per room is built, checked and observed, reported separately: checked means an automated check passes, observed means a person played it. Gym observations never set a feature manifest row to accepted. gaps record what the game cannot do yet and the room that exposed each one; closing a gap is separate default-off game work. key_registry lists every key already taken by the game and its labs before gym keys are chosen. See skills/studio-gym/SKILL.md.
